basic_profile.bio: A 24-year-old aspiring law student with a penchant for exploring educational opportunities abroad, particularly in Canada due to family ties. Based in the US, I am currently preparing for potential law school applications while working part-time at a local legal firm. I have a strong academic background with a 3.9 GPA and a high LSAT score in the 170s. I enjoy reading about technology and practicing coding skills in my free time. My online hours are mostly in the evenings and late at night, as I'm a bit of a night owl. Currently single and focusing on personal and professional growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in law and technology, built through formal education and continual self-study. My interest in law is complemented by a strong inclination towards technology, particularly cybersecurity, as evidenced by my participation in subreddits like 'oscp' and 'wellcode'.
